_readme: Run pacing tunables (spec Section 2). All values are balancing data, not code. survival_timer: seconds(level) = min(cap_seconds, base_seconds * product(1 + growth_rate * decay^i for i in 0..level-2)) — percentage growth that shrinks each level. enemy_spawn: interval(level, t) = max(min_interval, base_interval / (1 + level_factor*(level-1) + time_factor*t)); level 1 is the tutorial hook — its intervals are multiplied by level1_interval_mult. Spawns come in BATCHES that grow with level and time survived: batch = min(batch_max, 1 + (level-1)/batch_per_levels + t/batch_time_sec).
